stories.title: Pontblyddyn homeowner wins planning appeal after Flintshire Council refusal
stories.summary: A homeowner in Pontblyddyn has won a planning appeal after Flintshire County Council refused permission for a two-storey rear extension to his property. stories.title: Deeside A494 pollution below legal limit since 2020 but question mark remains over 50mph limit’s role
stories.summary: Roadside air pollution on the A494 at Deeside has been below the legal limit every year since 2020, almost eight years after a 50mph speed limit came into force on the stretch between St Davids Interchange and Deeside Park Interchange. stories.title: Wales Health Minister pledges to eliminate two-year NHS waits within months in first Senedd statement
stories.summary: Wales’s new Health Minister has pledged to eliminate two-year NHS waiting times “within months” and return the overall patient backlog to pre-pandemic levels before the end of this Senedd term.
